description:
Awaken your Mana.
A 2 hour Holistic class that merges the calming depths of the ocean with mindful movement and breath awareness. 

Unlock your full potential in the water with a class that blends freediving techniques with the power of breathwork, yoga, and meditation. Designed for those looking to refine their breath control, enhance relaxation, and move with greater efficiency beneath the surface, this session focuses on the physical mastery behind breath-hold diving. 
What to expect
Breathwork: Learn techniques to optimize efficiency, increase lung capacity, and improve relaxation.
Yoga: Develop mind to body awareness, improve flexibility, and core strength. 
Meditation & Mental Training: Build Mental awareness and resilience, extend breath-hold times, and deepen mind and body connections. 
Freediving-Specific Techniques: Connecting the power of meditation, relaxation, and breathwork to freediving techniques.  You will learn specific ways to dive deep, relax, and trust. Find your depth both within and under the ocean.
what_is_included:
*Yoga, Breathwork, Meditation skills
*Freedive and Equalization workshop
*Freedive Coaching
what_is_not_included:
yoga matt/ towels
freediving equipment **call the shop to rent if needed
